purpose: TT-BATCH (owner option B, one large batch): s81ph-dsfd_colt_lane-7345266ce-e-lbc re-routed at ORFS CORNER=TC (setup repair at TT), flow-hold mm FF hold HM 50, rule H1, CTS fix hooks + consistent die-link budget; original source commit kept; verdict TT setup >= 0 / FF hold >= 0 / DRC 0, SS = sensitivity. | was: SETUP-TRIAGE requeue of s81ph-dsfd_colt_lane-7345266ce-e (SS 47.24 / FF 21.73): flow fixes (physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl; post_sdc +['physical/common_flow/link_budget_consistent.sdc']) + flow-hold mm hold repair; source = origin/main + setup-triage fixes, no RTL change by this stream.

calibrate.cmd: TTB=$(ls -d /srv/opentallas-scratch/claude/ttbatch/26f14af32 /home/ubuntu/closure-loop-local/ttbatch/26f14af32 2>/dev/null | head -1) && export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 $TTB/tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/s81_ph_views/common/signoff_unc60.sdc'; HM=0.035 SRC={SRC} OUT={RUN}/routes CORES=16 NEED=32 SRCS='rtl/link/ot_fifo_sram_fwft.sv rtl/common/ot_fwd_link_stage.sv' MACROS='ot_sram_1r1w_256x256_m2_r2c2=physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_256x256_m2_r2c2' PDN=physical/s81_ph_views/tiles/pdn_tile_sym.tcl SDCX=physical/s81_ph_views/tiles/colt_lane_mcp.sdc CLK=ck bash physical/s81_ph_views/common/route_view.sh {LABEL}${CL_LABEL_SUFFIX} contract dsfd_colt_lane rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/ot_s81ph_col_tile.sv --orfs-var MACRO_PLACEMENT_TCL=/src/physical/s81_ph_views/tiles/place_macros_tile.tcl $CL_STOP_AFTER

route.cmd: TTB=$(ls -d /srv/opentallas-scratch/claude/ttbatch/26f14af32 /home/ubuntu/closure-loop-local/ttbatch/26f14af32 2>/dev/null | head -1) && export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 $TTB/tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/s81_ph_views/common/signoff_unc60.sdc'; SDCM=physical/s81_ph_views/common/io_vclk_m_${CK_SS_MEAN}.sdc HM=0.035 SRC={SRC} OUT={RUN}/routes CORES=16 NEED=32 SRCS='rtl/link/ot_fifo_sram_fwft.sv rtl/common/ot_fwd_link_stage.sv' MACROS='ot_sram_1r1w_256x256_m2_r2c2=physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_256x256_m2_r2c2' PDN=physical/s81_ph_views/tiles/pdn_tile_sym.tcl SDCX=physical/s81_ph_views/tiles/colt_lane_mcp.sdc CLK=ck bash physical/s81_ph_views/common/route_view.sh {LABEL}${CL_LABEL_SUFFIX} contract dsfd_colt_lane rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/ot_s81ph_col_tile.sv --orfs-var MACRO_PLACEMENT_TCL=/src/physical/s81_ph_views/tiles/place_macros_tile.tcl $CL_STOP_AFTER

budget.reason: S81-PH tile sheet is grade 'target' (no calibration); the tiles' measured insertion (~250 ps) is far below it, so the sheet SDC would put vclk hundreds of ps late (output hold model -> mass hold buffering). Routed on the calibrated MEASURED insertion (STANDARD FLOW); calib.json in the record for the sheet re-plan.
